create_SpotEnv: create a SpotEnv instance with an xml path and config to initialize a Boston Dynamics Spot simulation environment
build_get_assets: build a dictionary of model assets by loading XML files from the spot and boston_dynamics_spot menagerie paths
test_get_gravity: test the get_gravity method that returns the gravity vector in the world frame from mjx simulation data
test_get_feet_pos: test the get_feet_pos method that returns the position of all feet relative to the robot trunk
review_SpotEnv_sensor_methods: review the SpotEnv sensor reading methods including get_global_linvel, get_local_linvel, get_accelerometer, and get_gyro
